title: V01-C12 Nested and Composite Control Flow Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: A complete feasible-path list and state trace for nested flow; a behavior-preserving simplification using named predicates, a guard, or an early exit; and tests demonstrating normal, boundary, invalid, and previously missed paths.

accessibility_requirements: Every diagram has an equivalent text explanation.
Path tables label inputs, outer decision, inner decision, action, and resulting state.
Turkish terms include English only at first meaningful use.
Code comments and explanations are Turkish.
known_risks: State changes may be lost while tracing nested flow.
A break may be assumed to exit more than the innermost loop.
Syntactic paths may be confused with feasible paths.
Flattening may alter else ownership or side-effect order.
A complexity metric may be treated as a universal quality verdict.
Tests may cover only the happy path.
